The wearer is inside a narrow wire-mesh passage, approaching a low blue barrier. Their hand can reach only the nearby mesh; the stacked bricks and worker remain several metres ahead, beyond the barrier. One worker is visible near the brick piles, generally oriented toward the passage, while nobody directly occupies the wearer’s immediate path. Because the materials are not within reach and no urgent hazard is evident, asking the worker for a progress update is the most appropriate interaction.
